Triage: lands in `domain:skills` (lane self-triage; the enqueue bar is this lane's charter text and the landing discipline is this seat's own); rationale: class (b)-shaped — a declared contract (SKILL.md :629 「入队资格 = PR 上每一个 check 全绿」) that no landing can satisfy because `skipped` is the normal outcome of a path-filtered job and the charter defines no state for it, while the platform-readings discipline rightly says a skip is not a pass — so a seat holding both lines has no spelling for the one distinction that matters (an expected skip vs. a filter miss). This seat's own 26 landings today read 「success = green, skipped = not failed」 by convention, which is exactly the unstated rule the card names. Direction: (1) re-key :629 in place (≤120 B, SKILL.md at its ceiling 812/812, no new line) so the bar reads 「每一个 check 为 success 或预期 skip」 with the expected-skip set named by a machine-readable roster, and (2) a `scripts/pm/` check (with self-test) that reads a head's check-runs and reports any skipped check outside the roster as a filter miss — the roster declared once, in the check, and measured from the recurring skipped family (`Auto Label` · `Check PR Size` · `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)` · `Console Pin Gate` · `Build Docs`, plus whatever a full enumeration of the last N landings shows). The SKILL.md half is the rules layer (four-piece + an authorized APPROVED); the check is non-governed. Graded 2026-09-15T17:30Z: p3 · Task · `pm:queue` · `domain:skills` (no landing is blocked today — the convention holds — so not p2). Dedup by the card's five terms over the newest 303 issues, open and closed, back to 2026-09-11T09:10Z: no sibling. Serial: SKILL.md is held by no open PR of this lane (PR #18315 touches AGENTS.md, PR #18317 touches settings / the roster gate / rest-channel); dispatchable when a slot frees, after the two governed PRs awaiting approval land — the seat prefers not to stack a third rules-layer PR on the approvers.
